description: MCP server for the Simple Support System helpdesk API: read, answer and move tickets.
name: io.github.bitterdev/simple-support-system-mcp

environmentVariables.description: Base URL of the Concrete CMS site running the Simple Support System package

environmentVariables.description: Default access token for private projects
environmentVariables.name: SIMPLE_SUPPORT_SYSTEM_PROJECT_TOKEN
